name: AppLovin

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org (5000x1124 px) - Wikipedia infobox logo file: AppLovin logo.png

description: AppLovin is now a pure advertising-technology company. Its Axon engine runs auctions at microsecond speed that match advertisers (mainly mobile game makers, increasingly other app categories and e-commerce) with app publishers' ad space, and it is paid per impression or per action on spend that flows through it. It also owns MAX (an app-monetisation tool for publishers), Adjust (measurement and attribution) and Wurl (connected-TV streaming distribution). It sold its own mobile games (the Apps business) to Tripledot on 2025-06-30 and now reports one segment. With about 900 employees it had $4.15B operating income on $5.48B revenue in 2025.

gics.note: Conventional label as listed in the Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' table (GICS sector and GICS sub-industry columns). That table does not give the industry group or industry levels, so they are null rather than filled from memory.

hq.note: 1100 Page Mill Road (FY2025 10-K); incorporated in Delaware July 2011

employees.note: 876 full-time and 22 part-time/interns in 15 countries; about 380 in R&D (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Advertising (single segment)
businessLines.how: Advertisers pay AppLovin per impression or per action on an auction basis; AppLovin pays the publishers that show the ad and keeps the difference, with Axon's machine-learning improving match quality and price. Measurement (Adjust) and publisher tools (MAX) are sold as software.
businessLines.description: Axon Ads Manager (AI-powered matching of advertiser demand with publisher supply), MAX, Adjust, Wurl.
